## Verdict: PASS on DG5 round 6

Candidate `sha256:3294f8fc…` (2191 files, source `ad52a56`) was confirmed on a complete disposable clone three times: at the start, at the source commit and at the end. Every check in the assignment ran; none is BLOCKED.

### My open finding, F-DG5-147: closed and verified
- **Round-5 reproduction re-run:** my round-5 title probe, with the same data, screens and sizes plus an unbroken Arabic token, now asserts its result.
  - It passed 4 of 4 runs (en and ar, locale unset and C.UTF-8): 0 px overflow on every page heading, breadcrumb and card title at 390 px, 320 px and 200 % text.
  - In round 5 the same cases overflowed by 44–2797 px.
  - axe reports nothing, and an ordinary title still fits on one line at 1280 px.
- **Wider sweep:** 432 measurements per run across all 42 workspace tabs, 5 global pages, the Define outcome title and the T13 "Form tools" dialog title. Everything the repair targets wraps.

### New findings (both Low, not mandatory, REQ-S15-009, final gate DG6; neither blocks DG5)
- **F-DG5-148:** the same problem remains on two older (DG4) screens the repair didn't cover. On Traceability (the record link) and Modular entry (the missing-item label), an unbroken record name widens the page by 137–1658 px. Ordinary text gives 0 px.
- **F-DG5-149:** the Define page's outcome card has a fixed width of about 352 px because its "Good outcome" table has no scroll region. So the page scrolls sideways even with ordinary text:
  - en: 61 px at 320 px, 21 px at 360 px, 6 px at 375 px;
  - ar: 29 px at 320 px;
  - 0 px at 390 px, the only width earlier rounds measured.

### Everything else
- **Static checks:** all seven exit 0.
- **Unit tests:** 2341 / 1713 / 259 + 2 skipped on Node 22 and 24, in both locale settings. The stderr output is identical to round 5.
- **Integration (run twice):** 319/319 files, 3076 tests passed plus 1 deliberate skip. 89 migrations apply, the contract test covers 846 operations, and all 43 p5-pending lists are empty. `tests/qa` alone passes 336/336.
- **End-to-end:**
  - product journeys 454/454 in each locale setting;
  - root acceptance specs 30/30 ×2 and demo specs 12/12 ×2;
  - 52 auditor read-only tests per locale setting;
  - axe found 0 violations.
- **REQ-DLV-037:** A06 27, A07 12, A15 34 and A16 30 tests pass in every run.
- **Exported files:** 26 sample packs and registers (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV) in en and ar carry their labels; the Arabic ones are right-to-left. On the demo stack, the T01 and T14 form-record CSV and JSON files, downloaded through the UI, carry the illustrative label in both languages.
- **Validators:** `--register DG5`, `--pipeline` and `--historical` for DG4, DG3, DG2 and DG1 all pass.
- **Requirements:** all 78 rows trace to 406 named tests, every one of which passed this round.

### Disclosed in the record
- **Two setup errors in my own probes, both fixed in revision 2.** The title probe used an uppercase sign-in username, which returned 400. The export probe looked for the T14 Export button on the wrong page and timed out. Both first versions and their logs are kept.
- **My first `format:check` failed only on my own probe file**, which was in the clone during the scan. The clean re-run exits 0.
- **The assignment contradicts itself:** it says `round: 5` and task `…-R5`, but the paths and my invocation say round 6. The validator requires the record's round to match its folder, so the record uses 6.
- **The main repo moved during my run:** the other two reviewers' records were auto-committed. The candidate ID is unchanged, and I didn't open those records.
- **Documentation gap, no behavioural effect:** ADR-0041 §5 and ADR-0050 §2(d) don't yet describe the form-export label path.

I deleted the disposable clone. I couldn't delete the remaining scratch files under `$TMPDIR` because a safety check refused the removal; the runner clears that directory when the run ends.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-6/`:
- qa-verifier.json
- qa-verifier.verifications.json
- qa-verifier.findings.json
- qa-verifier.md
